stepTitle: Compared to the "mean 4th power error" loss function $$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}**{N}(tip_i-\theta_0)**{4}$$ the MAE is more robust to outliers.
stepBody: Michael decides to fit the following constant model: $$\hat{y}=\theta_0.$$ He first considers using the mean absolute error (MAE) as the objective function. Select the statements below that are true.
